title: What If Every Star Went Out Tonight?
title_it: E se stanotte si spegnessero tutte le stelle?
idea: Every star but the Sun switches off at midnight, and nobody notices for years: starlight is old light, so the sky goes dark one star at a time, and some of the stars we see may already be gone.
hook: What if every star in the sky went out tonight?
caption:
What if every star in the sky switched off at midnight? 🌌 You wouldn't notice for years. Starlight is old light, so some of the stars you see tonight may already be gone. 🦊🏮

Which star would you stay up to watch go out? Tell us below 👇
first_comment: Fun fact: the light from the North Star left it centuries ago. Which star would you watch? ✨
